entries.reason: iOS 6 has no +contextWithCGContext: in either spelling - the 6.1.3 selector table has contextWithOptions:, contextWithEAGLContext: and contextWithEAGLContext:options: and nothing to extend - so the context here is one of the release's own, made by the release's own method, with the drawing surface beside it
entries.effect: a context of the release's own, made with the release's own +contextWithOptions:, that draws into the CGContext named; a category cannot add storage to a class the framework has, so the surface is an associated object on the context
entries.source: the header of the iOS 16.4 SDK for the contract; the host's own CoreImage over the same calls, by tests/backports/host/ciimage/pixel, which draws into a CGContext on both sides and prints the bytes that context ended up holding; the 6.1.3 armv7 selector table for what the release has
